items.title: Ford Motor (F) Brings In Marissa West To Lead Its 2029 Vehicle Refresh
items.summary: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) hired former General Motors executive Marissa West as Vice President of Vehicle Programs. West will oversee Ford's vehicle development and lead a broad product portfolio refresh that runs through 2029. Her remit includes new electric models and midsize pickup trucks across both commercial and consumer product lines. items.title: S&P revises GM outlook to positive on widening margins and cash flow
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings has revised its credit outlook on General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) and subsidiary General Motors Financial Co. Inc. to positive from stable, citing significant margin recovery and expanding cash generation. S&P affirmed its 'BBB' issuer credit ratings on both entities, pointing to a potential upgrade over the next 12 to 24 months.
